Usage: cli-device [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Let AI drive all your devices — safety-gated CLI for any declarative device
  bundle.

Options:
  --bundle TEXT  Device bundle name (under bundles/) or directory path.
  --target TEXT  Execution target from device.yaml (e.g. in_memory).
  --socket TEXT  Unix socket path for cli-device-d.  [default: /tmp/cli-
                 device-d.sock]
  --json         Emit JSON envelope.
  --dry-run      Check safety gates and print plan without actuating.
  --confirm      Confirm physical or high-risk actions (R2-real/R3/R4).
  -h, --help     Show this message and exit.

Toolkit Commands:
  bundle  Draft, validate, compile, and list declarative device bundles.
  repl    Interactive session reusing top-level --bundle/--target/--socket
          flags.

  Pass --bundle <name|dir> (or CLI_DEVICE_BUNDLE) to load device commands.
  Software abort never replaces a physical power-cut emergency stop.
